items.title: How much of the field's yearly churn you can sustainably absorb
items.description: A simplified model of L2's pacing point: given how many hours a week you can realistically give to learning, and how many hours it takes to get genuinely competent in one new thing, what share of the field's yearly output can you actually cover? Drag the churn rate up and watch coverage drop even though nothing about your own effort changed.

params.name: hoursPerWeek
params.label: Hours per week available for learning

params.name: hoursPerThing
params.label: Hours to reach genuine competence in one new thing

params.name: churnRate
params.label: New significant things the field produces per year

items.compute: const capacityPerYear = (params.hoursPerWeek * 52) / params.hoursPerThing; const coverage = Math.min(100, (capacityPerYear / params.churnRate) * 100); return { coveragePercent: Math.round(coverage * 10) / 10 };

outputs.label: Share of the year's churn you can sustainably absorb
